reason: 翻译准确。

original:

despised the darkness so much…?
issue: 人名未翻译；句义衔接欠佳

改为：‘克拉迪雷夫：既然她总是……

original: Kradyrev: I poured all my heart into my creations, all for the betterment of Lumina.
reason: betterment意为‘改善、变得更好’，不是‘繁荣发展’。

reason: 翻译准确。

original: Kradyrev: … I surrender. My anger and bitterness, I surrender them all.

reason: 翻译准确。

issue: 标题人名保留英文，不符合中文译名
reason: Lucentia和Kradyrev应使用已译名，并保持统一。
suggestion: 改为‘卢森蒂亚与克拉迪雷夫的对话’。

reason: 翻译准确。

original: Wispy: Sylphy! We're back in Polar Solium…
reason: 翻译准确。

reason: 翻译准确。

reason: “Witness Her Highness’s return!”是‘见证殿下的归来吧！’，译文变成了疑问句。

reason: 同前，Lucentia应统一为‘卢森蒂亚’。
suggestion: 改为‘卢森蒂亚：唉，那黑暗的邪恶主人依然在我面前。’

original: Wispy: Your Highness… Forgive me, for the things that I'm about to say may be deemed presumptuous, and perhaps even treacherous.
reason: Wispy应统一为‘威斯皮’。

reason: Wispy和Kradyrev均保留英文，应使用中文译名。
suggestion: 改为‘威斯皮：不过，请这次不要谴责克拉迪雷夫。’

original: Wispy: I realize that darkness can oftentimes be seen as harrowing and filled with nothing but villainy.
reason: harrowing是‘令人痛苦/折磨的’，不是‘令人不安’。
suggestion: 改为‘威斯皮：我明白，黑暗常常被视为痛苦不堪，而且除了邪恶一无所有。’

original: Wispy: But throughout my journey, I have witnessed and learnt of its necessity to accompany that same Light which you hold within you, Your Highness.
reason: 原文是见证并认识到‘黑暗陪伴光明的必要性’，译文拆句后缺少主语，逻辑断裂。
suggestion: 改为‘威斯皮：但在旅途中，我亲眼见证并认识到，黑暗有必要陪伴着您心中的那道光芒，陛下。’

original: Wispy: Wherever Light appears, darkness shall exist. One simply cannot live without the other.
reason: 原文说‘两者离开对方都无法存在’，译文‘两者缺一不可，无法共存’自相矛盾，且‘无法共存’表达错误。
suggestion: 改为‘威斯皮：哪里有光，哪里就有黑暗。两者缺一不可。’

original: Lucentia: The world needs no misery and adversity to prosper, little one. Light is the only honesty in this world.
issue: “honesty”译作‘真理’不准确；人名不一致
reason: honesty是‘诚实/真实’，不是‘真理’；Lucentia应统一为‘卢森蒂亚’。
suggestion: 改为‘卢森蒂亚：孩子，世界不需要苦难和逆境就能繁荣。光明才是这世上唯一真实的东西。’

original: Kradyrev: The ‘little one’ you are addressing has traversed the heights and depths of Lumina just to gather all of your broken pieces.
reason: 翻译基本准确。

original: Kradyrev: And during its journey, your loyal subject travelled together with a being of my darkness.
reason: ‘a being of my darkness’应为‘一个属于我黑暗的存在/造物’，译文不符合中文习惯。
suggestion: 改为‘克拉迪雷夫：在它的旅途中，你忠诚的仆从与一个属于我黑暗的存在一同前行。’

original: Kradyrev: Together, they succeeded. See for yourself now that they have revived you as you once were.
reason: revive是复活/使复原，不是‘重获容颜’，原文并未提容貌。
suggestion: 改为‘克拉迪雷夫：他们共同努力，最终成功了。现在你亲眼看看吧——他们让你恢复成了原来的样子。’

original: Kradyrev: Small as they may be, they have been the simplest symbol of how Light and Dark demand each other to coexist.
reason: 翻译准确。

original: Kradyrev: Surely, this truth shall not escape your conscience, Lucentia?
issue: “不会逃过你的良心”表述生硬
reason: conscience作‘良知’更自然；全句应体现反问语气。
suggestion: 改为‘克拉迪雷夫：想必这个真相不会被你的良知忽视吧，卢森蒂亚？’

original: Lucentia: ...I... see. I believe I must thank you, little one, for your relentless efforts to bring me back.
reason: 此处指‘将我带回/复活’，不是‘恢复健康’。
suggestion: 改为‘卢森蒂亚：……我……明白了。小家伙，我必须感谢你，感谢你不懈努力将我带回。’

original: Lucentia: Your journey has truly saved Lumina from the inevitable demise that would have occured had my misunderstanding persist.
reason: your journey是‘你的旅程’，不是‘你的付出’；Lumina应统一保留为‘Lumina’。
suggestion: 改为‘卢森蒂亚：你的旅程确实拯救了Lumina，使其免于因我的误解持续而必然降临的毁灭。’

original: Lucentia: Sighs. The throne of darkness belongs to none but you after all, Kradyrev. Let us both return.
reason: Sighs. 是动作提示/叹气声，可直接译作‘（叹气）’或‘唉’；Lucentia译名需统一。
suggestion: 改为‘卢森蒂亚：（叹气）毕竟，黑暗的王座只属于你一人，克拉迪雷夫。让我们一起回去吧。’

original: Kradyrev: We must renew our testament, as rulers of Lumina. To prevent this tragedy from ever repeating itself.
reason: 此处为统治者之间的‘盟约/誓约’，不是法律上的‘遗嘱’。
suggestion: 改为‘克拉迪雷夫：作为Lumina的统治者，我们必须重新缔结盟约，防止这场悲剧重演。’

original: Lucentia: Very well. It shall be our first act after you reclaim the throne.
reason: 翻译准确。

original: Wispy: Uhm, excuse me… Where is Kimo?
reason: Wispy应统一为‘威斯皮’。
suggestion: 改为‘威斯皮：呃，不好意思……基莫在哪儿？’

original: Kradyrev: Ah, my little creature. He has returned to where he belongs.
reason: 翻译准确。

original: Wispy: Wh-where is that? Will I be able to see him again?
reason: 翻译准确。

original: Wispy: I-I want to see him. Please, can I see him...?
reason: ‘维斯皮’应统一为‘威斯皮’。
suggestion: 改为‘威斯皮：我……我想见他。拜托，我还能见见他吗……？’

original: Kradyrev: I'm afraid he is beyond your reach now.
reason: 翻译准确。
翻译准确。

original: Kradyrev: But perhaps one day, you may be able to see him again.
reason: 翻译准确。
翻译准确。

original: Kradyrev: There may yet be a chance for that.
reason: Kradyrev应统一为‘克拉迪雷夫’。
suggestion: 改为‘克拉迪雷夫：也许还有机会。’

reason: 翻译准确。

original: Wispy: My dearest friend. It's such a shame for us to part here.
reason: 翻译准确。

original: Wispy: I hope we can see each other again soon...
reason: Wispy应统一为‘威斯皮’。
suggestion: 改为‘威斯皮：希望我们很快能再见面……’

reason: 翻译准确。

original:
Golden Dawn of Fairies I:

A palace of solitude, floating above the land and away from the disturbance of the population below. No words would suffice to quench one's curiosity of the beauty that brings souls to marvel. The buildings in the city stand resplendent and every single Fairy live in peace and harmony. They all live under an esteemed union with one noble purpose.

And that is to serve Lucentia.
issue: “A palace of solitude”和“quench one's curiosity”翻译不准确
reason: 应为‘孤寂的宫殿/与世隔绝的宫殿’；‘suffice to quench curiosity’是‘满足好奇心’，不是‘描述景象’。
suggestion: 改为：‘精灵的金色黎明 I：一座孤寂的宫殿，悬浮于大地之上，远离下方居民的喧嚣。没有任何语言足以满足人们对那种令灵魂惊叹之美的好奇。城中的建筑辉煌夺目，每一位精灵都生活在和平与和谐之中。他们都生活在一种崇高的联盟之下，怀着一个共同的目标——那就是侍奉卢森蒂亚。’

original:
Golden Dawn of Fairies II:

Her gaze never falters. She sits alone on her throne as if bestowed upon her the curse to forever appease the severity and heartaches of the world. From her palace, she watches over Lumina. Nothing escapes her divine gaze, for Light will always irradiate the land with its grace. But then, what about those who live below the ground, enshrouded with an everlasting crepuscule and remain untouched by her divine Light?
reason: 标题应为‘精灵的金色黎明 II’；crepuscule是‘黄昏/微光’，不是‘黑暗’。
suggestion: 改为：‘精灵的金色黎明 II：她的目光从不游移。她独自坐在王座上，仿佛被诅咒要永远平息世间的严峻与悲伤。从她的宫殿，她守护着Lumina。没有什么能逃过她神圣的目光，因为光明永远以优雅照耀大地。然而，那些生活在地下、被永恒的微光笼罩、从未被她神圣之光照耀的人呢？’

original:
Golden Dawn of Fairies III:

Fairies are born and live in this place. Being a nation of their own, each one of them has a duty to perform as a contribution to serve Lucentia's light. Forever grateful, perpetually indebted to be of service. Praises are sung and danced, shadows and misery be forgotten for so long as they keep their face towards the Light. Deep in the caliginosity of shadows, jealousy is born and bred. As disputes and fruitless efforts swerve in aimless direction, one might wonder, is the Light truly good or bad?
issue: 标题不统一；“swerve in aimless direction”译法不准确；Lucentia未译
reason: 标题应为‘精灵的金色黎明 III’；该短语意为‘漫无目的地偏转’，不是‘偏离正确方向’；Lucentia应统一译名。
suggestion: 改为：‘精灵的金色黎明 III：精灵们出生并生活于此。作为独立的民族，他们每个人都有责任为卢森蒂亚的光辉服务。他们永远心怀感激，永远为此效劳。只要面向光明，赞美与歌舞不停，阴影与苦难便被遗忘。在阴影的黑暗深处，嫉妒滋生繁衍。当争端与徒劳在漫无目的中偏转时，人们不禁要问：光明究竟是善是恶？’

original:
Diary 1:

Everything proceeds as it should today. Nothing is out of hand, everything is in control. Supposedly, her Highness should be in peace and serenely reigning, yet… Her Highness seems very restless still.

What caused this restlessness? Did we not do our job right? When the other fairy asked, Her Highness would not answer and even dismissed the question.

I fear something dark might happen soon…
reason: Supposedly是‘按理说’，不是‘据说’；dismissed the question是‘不予理会/打发掉问题’，不是‘拒绝回答’。
suggestion: 改为：‘日记1：今天一切照常。没有事情失控，一切尽在掌握。按理说，殿下应当安宁平和地统治，然而……殿下似乎仍很不安。是什么引起了这种不安？是我们没有尽到职责吗？当另一位精灵提问时，殿下没有回答，甚至不予理会。我担心很快会有黑暗的事情发生……’

original: Wispy: Oh… Well you can still help us if we need a ride, right?
reason: Wispy 在其他条目中译为“威斯皮”，此处保留英文。
suggestion: 威斯皮：哦……如果我们需要乘车的话，你仍然可以帮助我们，对吧？

original: Roque: Only temporarily, because soon enough, I'll be able to execute the grand plan to reach my goal!
reason: Roque 在其他条目中译为“罗克”，此处保留英文。
suggestion: 罗克：只是暂时的而已，因为很快我就能实施那个宏伟的计划，从而实现我的目标！

original: Wispy: Great, we can still travel to other places, Kimo.
reason: 译文准确表达原文含义。

original: Wispy:  Use this opportunity wisely if there's still places you want to explore that we haven’t visited yet.
reason: Wispy 在其他条目中译为“威斯皮”，此处保留英文。
suggestion: 威斯皮：如果还有你想去但我们还没去过的地方，那就好好利用这个机会吧。

original: Roque: Hey, are you even listening to me?!
reason: “到底在听不我在说话”不符合中文语法，应为“到底有没有在听我说话”。
suggestion: 罗克：嘿，你到底有没有在听我说话？！

reason: 译文准确。

original: Roque: Ah, yes. You wish for a ride? Well go on, help yourself. I’m quite busy with my own plan.
reason: help yourself 是“请自便/随便用”，不是“自己享受”；go on 未译出。
suggestion: 罗克：啊，对。你想乘车？那去吧，请自便。我正忙着实施我自己的计划。

reason: 标题使用英文 Kimi/Sylphy，但后文对话中分别译为“基米/西尔菲”。
suggestion: 与基米和西尔菲的会面

reason: Sylphy 应统一为“西尔菲”。

original: Sylphy: Kradyrev has been awaiting you in Lucentia’s Hall of Audience.
issue: 译名不统一；Hall of Audience 可更准确
reason: Lucentia 前后出现卢森提亚/卢森蒂亚等；Hall of Audience 更接近“觐见厅”。
suggestion: 西尔菲：克拉迪雷夫已在卢森蒂亚的觐见厅等你。

original: Sylphy: I’m sure we're all aware that a battle will be unavoidable the moment you decide to confront him.
reason: Sylphy 应统一为“西尔菲”。
suggestion: 西尔菲：我相信我们都明白，一旦你决定与他对抗，战斗就不可避免。

original: Sylphy: But don't worry, you’re not alone. The valiant warriors of Polar Solium will aid you in your fight against Kradyrev.
reason: Polar Solium 建议使用统一中文译名，如“极地索利姆”。
suggestion: 西尔菲：不过不用担心，你并不孤单。极地索利姆的勇敢战士会帮助你对抗克拉迪雷夫。

original: Sylphy:  Still, you must be very careful.
reason: Sylphy 应统一为“西尔菲”。
suggestion: 西尔菲：不过，你还是必须非常小心。

reason: Sylphy 应统一为“西尔菲”。

original: Sylphy: Kimi and I will evacuate the fairies out of harm's way. We will come to aid you should fate give us a chance.
reason: 译文准确传达原文含义。

original: Sylphy: Kimo… Whatever truth may lay itself before your eyes… I hope you will be able to accept it and face it…
issue: 语气、措辞不准确；角色名不统一
reason: 原文 I hope 是“我希望”，不是“你应该能够”；“whatever truth may lay itself before your eyes”未译出“展现在眼前”。
suggestion: 西尔菲：基莫……无论怎样的真相展现在你眼前……我都希望你能接受并面对它……

original: Sylphy: Your choices in these moments will be the key to Lumina’s salvation.
reason: key to salvation 是“拯救的关键”，不是“决定命运”；Lumina 前后译名不一致。
suggestion: 西尔菲：在这些时刻，你的选择将是拯救卢米纳（或统一译名）的关键。

reason: 译文准确。
标题使用英文 Kimi/Sylphy，但后文对话中分别译为“基米/西尔菲”。
suggestion: 与基米和西尔菲的会面

original: Sylphy: Once you go up, there's no turning back. Be sure you're prepared for anything.
issue: go up 漏译/译偏；角色名不统一
reason: Once you go up 应指“上去”，不是“继续前进”。
suggestion: 西尔菲：一旦你上去，就没有回头路了。务必确保你已做好万全准备。

original: Sylphy: While you're still here, is there anything you wish to accomplish first?

suggestion: 西尔菲：趁你还在这里，有没有什么想先完成的事？

issue: 增译导致语义变化；角色名不统一
reason: 原文没有“我知道”；应是“如果你还有别的地方想去”。
suggestion: 西尔菲：如果你还有别的地方想去，我正好带着一个传送铃铛。

original: I have somewhere to go to first.
reason: 译文准确。
译文准确。

reason: 译文准确表达原文含义。

original: Kradyrev: To think that my own kin would come to oppose me.

reason: reviving 若指复活 Lucentia 应译为“复活”而非“复兴”；“what kind of being”宜为“什么样的存在”而非“什么样的人”。
suggestion: 克拉迪雷夫：你真的还坚持要拯救并复活卢森蒂亚吗？被她的光芒蒙蔽……你根本不知道她是什么样的存在。

original: Kradyrev: What a fool. You will not stand a chance against me.
reason: 译文准确。
Normal Ending 在游戏语境中通常叫“普通结局”，“正常结局”生硬。

original: Kradyrev: How ironic… That everything has come to this.
reason: 译文准确。

original: Kradyrev: Do you simply blindly follow every instruction that little fairy offers you?
reason: 译文准确。

original: Kradyrev: You, who are a part of me… All your journeying, yet the truth continues to elude you?
reason: 译文准确。

original: Kradyrev: How can darkness ever be removed completely from the light? It cannot be.
reason: 译文准确。

original: Kradyrev: There is no one capable of ruling the darkness, the shadows, those who lurk in the shades, but one as myself.

suggestion: 除了像我这样的存在，没有人能够统治黑暗、阴影和那些潜藏在阴暗中之物。

original: Kradyrev: And she would rule it even as she loathes it. Simply because the very darkness itself is unsightly.

original: Kradyrev: Fools. It was she who tipped the balance of this world when she imprisoned me.
reason: when she imprisoned me 是时间状语，不是“通过囚禁我”这一手段；tipped the balance 更常用“打破平衡”。
suggestion: 克拉迪雷夫：蠢货们。正是她，在囚禁我的时候，打破了这世界的平衡。

original: Kradyrev: Even this battle just now…
reason: 译文准确。

original: Kradyrev: Your fairy friend was born of light and you of darkness, and yet, you came together to defeat me.
reason: 译文准确。

original: Kradyrev: That alone proves that light and darkness cannot be separated.
reason: 译文准确。

original: Kradyrev: Your spirit is commendable. Despite every obstacle, you found your way here. You never gave up.
reason: 译文准确。

Glasshouse of Wisdom I: Many creatures used to live under shadows and their fate was as unsettled as the wind that whisks through forests and rivers. Their future was uncertain and there was nothing capable of defying the poignant reality. 

Sonata Glade, the place did not always please the eye as it does today. As far as the eye could see, there was only water everywhere. The ground to live on was so small and barely habitable, sheltered by damp darkness no matter where one cast their gaze. Cold and scattered, dark and scrutinised by looming disasters, yet the villagers insisted on inhabiting said place. With what little effort they could muster, every individual made do to live.
issue: 翻译不忠实：原文末尾不完整，译文自行补全；“scrutinised by looming disasters”译成“充满危险的气息”不够准确
reason: 原文在“inhabiti”处截断，译文应保持未完成或根据已知内容合理处理，不应补充；且该短语直译为“被迫近的灾难所注视/笼罩”
suggestion: 保留原文的未完状态或标注缺失；“Cold and scattered, dark and scrutinised by looming disasters”可译为“寒冷而零落，黑暗且被逼近的灾难所笼罩”

original:
Glasshouse of Wisdom II: Like a diamond in the rough, his intelligence shone brightly among his peers. 

He descended down like a savior to his people. With his guidance, the land began to prosper and the crowd cheered on their feet. Where water used to engulf parts of the land, there were now grounds for who may inhabit and conserve it. The astute Titan created a mechanism whereby one can control the water level of the area, leading to a better habitat for the creatures to live in. 

Later, he appointed seven guardians to protect and maintain the mechanism everyday, one for each day.

An unforgettable memory of the Titan's generosity.
issue: 原文末尾“A”未完整，译文自行补全；“conserve it”误译成“耕种”；“one for each day”未译出

original: Days went by with the noble Titan teaching the people how to pray in the Temple. Patiently, she taught one thing after another with not even a single word of complaint. It was not like these people were ruffians, nor were they barbarians unfamiliar with the teachings of Light. In fact, they had been living well, and yet their faith and lives further prospered under her guidance.","Cahaya Bulan Dalam Kegelapan III: Hari-hari berlalu dengan Titan yang mulia itu mengajarkan para makhluk bagaimana cara berdoa di Kuil. Dengan sabar, ia mengajarkan setiap hal satu per satu, tanpa sedikitpun keluhan terdengar darinya. Bukan karena mereka adalah makhluk tidak beradab ataupun makhluk barbar yang tidak mengenal ajaran Cahaya. Nyatanya, justru mereka telah hidup dengan baik selama ini, dan di bawah bimbingannya, kehidupan mereka menjadi jauh lebih makmur.","Cuneiforme 6: Pasaron los días y el noble titán le enseñó al pueblo cómo orar en el templo. Con paciencia, enseñaba una cosa tras otra sin recibir ni un reclamo. No se trataba de rufianes, ni de bárbaros desconocedores de las enseñanzas de la luz. De hecho, llevaban buenas vidas, y su fe y sus vidas prosperaron aún más bajo su guía.","Clair de lune dans les ténèbres  III : Les jours passaient tandis que le noble titan apprenait aux gens à prier dans le temple. Patiemment, elle leur enseignait une chose après l'autre, sans jamais se plaindre. Ces gens n'étaient ni des voyous, ni des barbares étrangers aux enseignements de la Lumière. En effet, ils avaient jusqu'alors mené une vie honnête, et pourtant leur foi s'est épanouie et leur vie a davantage prospéré sous sa direction.","Mondlicht im Dunkeln III: Die Tage vergingen und die edle Titanin lehrte die Leute, wie sie am besten im Tempel beteten. Mit schier endloser Geduld brachte sie ihnen alles bei, ohne sich nur ein einziges Mal über ihre Aufgabe zu beschweren. Diese Leute waren keinesfalls Rüpel oder Barbaren, die noch nie von den Lehren des Lichts gehört hatten. Tatsächlich hatten sie bereits ein gutes Leben geführt, doch ihr Glaube und ihre Lebensfreude gediehen unter der Führung der Titanin wie nie zuvor.",闇に光る月光 III:高貴なタイタンが神殿にて、人々に祈りの方法を説く日々が送られていった。彼女は辛抱強く、何の不平も漏らすことなく、次々と教えを説いてくれた。この人々は、悪党であったり、光の教えに不慣れな野蛮人であったわけではなかった。実際、彼らは健全な暮らしをしていたのだが、彼女の教えの下、彼らの信仰と生活はさらに繁栄することとなったのである。,黑暗中的月光 III：时光飞逝，那位高贵的泰坦巨神教人们如何在神庙里祈祷。她不厌其烦地反复传道，没有一句怨言。当时的人们并非卑劣无赖，也并非不懂得光明教诲的野蛮之人。事实上大家生活安康，而且满怀信仰，在她的指引下不断繁荣进步。,"Cuneiforme 6: Dias se passaram com a nobre titã ensinando ao povo como rezar no templo. Pacientemente, ela ensinou uma pessoa após a outra sem reclamar nenhuma vez. Não que as pessoas fossem malfeitoras nem bárbaras desacostumadas aos ensinamentos da Luz. Na verdade, elas viveram muito bem e, assim, a fé e suas vidas prosperaram sob a orientação da titã.",
issue: 译文由大量重复/多语言版本堆叠，且有“Cuneiforme 6”“Clair de lune”等无关片段。

original:
Secret Cuneiform: I have traversed through all of Lumina, just as Her Highness requested.

I have witnessed many lives, studied many cultures, and acknowledged many bitter histories… All of which have been recorded in various cuneiforms, such the truth will not be buried by the ticking of time.

All this time, I- We have been living so comfortably up above, ignorant of the world below Polar Solium. Lumina is indeed in complete imbalance. As much as I hate to admit this.

We do need the darkness.

No light will endure without its shadows, just as the shadow cannot be cast without the light. The absence of one will tip the balance, inevitably leading to destruction.

I must report this grave situation to Her Highness as soon as possible. Yet I doubt she will care. Lucentia believes everything in Lumina to be in perfect order, nothing amiss. She won’t believe a word I say, of what I have witnessed with my own eyes.

It was a mistake for her to banish Kradyrev… His Highness from the throne. We should never have evicted him simply because he was of the darkness, for his creations of the Titans. The Titans themselves, despite their displeasing visages, have done so many good deeds for countless creatures in Lumina.

Now His Highness grows stronger and more powerful each day he is locked in his prison, fueled by anger and bitterness. It is only a matter of time before he will be free of his shackles.

I am filled with doubt and anxiety as I write this cuneiform. I don’t think I will be returning to Polar Solium, not with the knowledge that no single word of mine would be heeded. My deepest apologies for not returning, Your Highness… 

May the light continue to shine over the clouds and shadows... May the dark forever be the home of the moon and stars...
issue: 首句逻辑译反；Polar Solium 处理不一致；译文在原文截断处之后出现了无法对应的增译内容。
reason: 原文 No light will endure without its shadows 意为“没有阴影，光无法存续”，不是“没有光就没有阴影”；给出的原文止于 without the li，后续段落没有对应来源；Polar Solium 不应译作“极光之下”。
suggestion: 首句改为“没有阴影，光便无法存续；正如没有光，影子也无法形成”；Polar Solium 保留原名并统一；核对原文完整内容，删除或补全多出段落。

original:
Benang itu kabarnya ringan dan kuat. Ia dapat digunakan untuk berbagai macam hal, bahkan ia bisa juga digunakan sebagai pengganti untuk mengikat berbagai macam benda. Benang yang ia buat juga banyak membantu keseharian hidup banyak orang. Ia sulit dihancurkan dan sangat efektif untuk digunakan membangun konstruksi dan sarana pendukung lainnya. Benda yang amat sangat berguna dan diinginkan oleh banyak orang.
 
 Ia memberikan benang-benangnya dengan gratis, sebuah harga untuk menukar kesepiannya. Tinggi bak langit tak berujung harapan ia letakkan, melihat penawarannya terus berlanjut dari satu jiwa ke jiwa yang lain. Namun, tak peduli berapa banyak benang yang ia buat maupun malam yang lewat, tak satupun dari mereka datang untuk berkenalan. Dari seluruh masa penantiannya, hanya satu jiwa yang akhirnya datang untuk berteman.
issue: 翻译错误及内容擅自补充
reason: “menukar kesepiannya”是“排解/交换他的孤独”，不是“换取人们的孤独感”；且原文本在“dari satu”处截断，译文后半段补充了原文没有的内容。
suggestion: 按原文直译并保留截断，例如：“他免费送出他的线，以之作为排遣孤独的代价。他把高如无尽长空的希望寄托于此，看着他的赠予从一条……”（后续缺失处请用占位符注明）

Itu aneh sekali. Semua orang mengatakan kalau laba-laba itu adalah makhluk yang sangat jahat yang akan menyerang dan memakan siapapun yang memasuki wilayahnya. Mereka menyombongkan diri dengan mengatakan kalau mereka berhasil selamat darinya dan berhasil mendapatkan benangnya tanpa disakiti.
